title: [Used] IdeaPad 5x 2-in-1 Snapdragon X 14" OLED Touch Laptop (Scratch N Dent) 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD $429.75 Shipped @ Lenovo Outlet
body:
Deal: [Used] IdeaPad 5x 2-in-1 Snapdragon X 14" OLED Touch Laptop (Scratch N Dent) 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD $429.75 Shipped @ Lenovo Outlet

[Mortgagetightass] Is the RAM + Storage worth more than the laptop?
[Agret] It's a Snapdragon platform so it's basically like a phone, entire system on one board.
[witheredcouch] Have been trying to check out on this all morning, was getting a tax error. For $70 more the 1TB is the better deal given the more powerful cpu.
[Bacons] heads up for anyone considering, the X Plus variation they use in the 1tb model is X1P-42-100 not the faster 10 core model
Snapdragon X X1-26-100 8 core Standard model, with Adreno X1-45 graphics
Snapdragon X Plus X1P-42-100 8 core Modest performance gain; also uses Adreno X1-45 graphics
Snapdragon X Plus X1P-64-100 10 core More cores and stronger Adreno X1-85 graphics
[witheredcouch] Yeah it's essentially an upclocked version of the base model. Given the price difference and double the storage, for me it was worth it.
[witheredcouch] Glad i got it in time as I have been periodically trying since 9am but kept getting "tax error".
[witheredcouch] @Bargainaholic: I wasn't going to post a deal that I wasn't sure anybody could actually get due to the checkout not working. The plan was to post once checkout worked, but you beat me to it, this post reminded me to try again and it worked!
I have been on the fence on these looking at the outlet daily for the last few months.
[enjoylosing] I have been trying for various models too and been getting the tax error thing i dont know whats going on, I ended up buying a new laptop which was far more pricey I kind of regret it already
[witheredcouch] Eventually it worked, so who knows what is going on.
[enjoylosing] I think the store is not good especially at handling high volume, probably many items are OOS but showing in stock, and when stock is replenished whoever is fastest can check out
[tugman] I bought the non touch screen one two weeks ago for 529, and its a slick machine. It was almost brand new in terms of dent, it was tiny as the dent on top. For 429 with touch screen, you are stealing it.
[clandestino] Thanks OP - got the 1TB version. Been on the lookout for this one, for a while.
[MR-AM] Anyone else having issues checking out with Apple pay(
[witheredcouch] I tried every payment method throughout the morning and kept getting "tax error" until about 20 Mins ago, so something is up with the checkout.
[AaronL] Does cashback work on this? I'm trying to navigate to the product from the ShopBack link but can't find it
[Nonini] Since everyone will be here… Can someone please post some good smartphone deals? I'm tired of looking for a good deal on S26U or similar
[SKobb] Planning an overseas trip soon.. Something like this or a tablet for mostly watching movies?
[kennyboi] Is snapdragon going to cause certain compatibility issue for certain software?
[congo] Sorry, the inventory reservation is failed, product code 83GHX00AR1
[merajaan] Just an FYI for anyone considering buying this for their high school kids like I was - only x86 laptops are supported for the apps that will be used under the BYOD high school laptop program so this rules out any Snapdragon laptops unfortunately
[jonoz] Keep trying, just managed to buy the $429 one.
[Bargainaholic] There is the 8gb ram variant for $352 that is still in stock
